north.name: North
north.intro: Car workshops and services in the North region of Singapore, which takes in Yishun, Woodlands, Sembawang and Kranji. Some listings here are mobile or onsite and come to your car.

north-east.name: North-East
north-east.intro: Car workshops and services in the North-East region of Singapore, including Ang Mo Kio, Hougang, Sengkang, Punggol and Serangoon.

east.name: East
east.intro: Car workshops and services in the East region of Singapore, which includes the Kaki Bukit and Bedok car trade units.

west.name: West
west.intro: Car workshops and services in the West region of Singapore, including Bukit Batok, Bukit Panjang and Boon Lay. Listings here are mobile services or have an outlet in the west.

central.name: Central
central.intro: Car workshops and services in the Central region of Singapore, including Toa Payoh, Bukit Timah, Upper Thomson and the Jervois and Havelock Road areas.
